entries.en: His diary begins with his enlistment and ends with his return home.
entries.zh: 他的日记从入伍写起，到他回到家乡结束。

entries.en: The optician adjusted the frames so they sat comfortably on my nose.
entries.zh: 配镜师调整了镜框，让它舒服地架在我的鼻子上。

entries.en: The team discussed the failed experiment constructively and planned a new approach.
entries.zh: 团队建设性地讨论了这次失败的实验，并计划采用新方法。

entries.en: A large Roman numeral marked each chapter in the old book.
entries.zh: 这本旧书用一个大罗马数字标示每一章。

entries.en: His unusual irritability made even a simple conversation difficult that evening.
entries.zh: 那天晚上，他异常易怒，连简单交谈都变得困难。

entries.en: She brought her trusty old camera on every walking holiday.
entries.zh: 每次徒步度假，她都带着那台可靠的旧相机。

entries.en: The palace dining room offered a setting of almost princely splendor.
entries.zh: 宫殿餐厅的布置几乎有王侯般的奢华气派。

entries.en: The toy looked indestructible, but its wheels broke within a week.
entries.zh: 这个玩具看起来坚不可摧，但不到一周轮子就坏了。

entries.en: The unexpected delivery of blankets was a godsend to the stranded travelers.
entries.zh: 意外送到的毯子对被困旅客来说真是及时雨。

entries.en: The speaker stepped onto the dais and waited for the applause to fade.
entries.zh: 演讲者走上讲台，等掌声渐渐平息。

entries.en: She became the family's main breadwinner while her husband returned to college.
entries.zh: 丈夫重返大学期间，她成了家里主要的经济支柱。

entries.en: The designer's reinvention of the traditional chair attracted attention at the exhibition.
entries.zh: 这位设计师对传统椅子的重新设计在展览中引起了关注。

entries.en: The teacher showed how this verb can be used reflexively.
entries.zh: 老师展示了这个动词如何以反身形式使用。

entries.en: The school welcomed pupils from several different denominational backgrounds.
entries.zh: 这所学校欢迎来自几个不同教派背景的学生。

entries.en: The lecture explained how doctors assess whether a newly identified condition is treatable.
entries.zh: 讲座解释了医生如何评估一种新发现的病症是否可以治疗。

entries.en: He considered the ugly new building an abomination beside the historic square.
entries.zh: 他认为历史广场旁那座丑陋的新楼令人厌恶。

entries.en: The padre sat with the anxious soldiers before they left the camp.
entries.zh: 士兵们离开营地前，随军牧师陪着心情焦虑的他们坐了一会儿。

entries.en: Opening the upper windows improved airflow through the crowded classroom.
entries.zh: 打开上方的窗户后，拥挤教室里的空气流通改善了。

entries.en: The vagueness of the instructions left us uncertain about where to begin.
entries.zh: 说明过于含糊，让我们不知道该从哪里开始。

entries.en: After an uneventful journey, we arrived at the cottage before sunset.
entries.zh: 一路平安无事，我们在日落前到达了小屋。

entries.en: The report noted a brief period of unconsciousness after the fall.
entries.zh: 报告记载，跌倒后曾短暂失去知觉。

entries.en: The agreement granted the small publisher exclusivity for the first year.
entries.zh: 协议授予这家小出版社第一年的独占权。

entries.en: The fictional detective suspects that the charming visitor is a psychopath.
entries.zh: 小说中的侦探怀疑那位富有魅力的访客是个精神变态者。

entries.en: The hospital opened a neonatal unit with space for twelve infants.
entries.zh: 医院开设了一个能容纳十二名婴儿的新生儿病区。

entries.en: The rival company covertly approached several members of the design team.
entries.zh: 竞争公司秘密接触了设计团队中的几名成员。

entries.en: The narrow entrance and steep stairs militate against using the building as a gallery.
entries.zh: 狭窄的入口和陡峭的楼梯不利于将这座建筑用作画廊。

entries.en: A steady drumbeat guided the dancers through the final part of the performance.
entries.zh: 稳定的鼓声引领舞者完成了演出的最后一部分。

entries.en: The engineer added a counterweight to balance the lifting arm.
entries.zh: 工程师加装了一块配重来平衡起重臂。

entries.en: The train crossed a featureless plain with hardly a tree in sight.
entries.zh: 火车穿过一片没有什么特色的平原，几乎看不到一棵树。

entries.en: The cleaner extended the telescopic handle to reach the upper windows.
entries.zh: 清洁工拉长伸缩杆，去擦高处的窗户。

entries.en: Years of estrangement ended when the brothers met at their aunt's birthday.
entries.zh: 兄弟俩在姑妈的生日聚会上见面，多年的疏远就此结束。

entries.en: The documentary records how prison guards brutalized people in their custody.
entries.zh: 纪录片记录了狱警如何残酷对待被关押的人。

entries.en: The fragile vase remained undamaged despite the torn and battered packaging.
entries.zh: 尽管包装破损不堪，易碎的花瓶仍然完好无损。

entries.en: The cafe replaced its foam trays with recyclable cardboard ones.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆用可回收的硬纸板托盘替换了泡沫托盘。

entries.en: The village has a population of eight hundred or thereabouts.
entries.zh: 这个村庄大约有八百人口。

entries.en: A wintry wind swept across the platform as we waited for the train.
entries.zh: 我们等火车时，一阵冬日般寒冷的风扫过站台。

entries.en: She took ahold of the railing before stepping onto the moving boat.
entries.zh: 她先抓住栏杆，再踏上晃动的船。

entries.en: Several chairs were knocked over in the melee outside the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 拥挤的大厅外发生混战，好几把椅子被撞倒了。

entries.en: The manufacturer impregnates the fabric with resin before shaping the panels.
entries.zh: 制造商先用树脂浸透织物，再将其制成板材。

entries.en: The artist spent months persuading officialdom to allow the street exhibition.
entries.zh: 这位艺术家花了几个月说服官僚机构批准街头展览。

entries.en: He blamed laziness for the unfinished chores, though everyone had been exhausted.
entries.zh: 他把没做完家务归咎于懒惰，尽管所有人都已筋疲力尽。

entries.en: The child crawled headfirst through the short tunnel at the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子头朝前爬过了游乐场里的短隧道。

entries.en: Their brown spaniel carried a tennis ball around the garden all afternoon.
entries.zh: 他们那只棕色长毛垂耳犬整个下午都叼着网球在花园里转。

entries.en: She lowered her voice to a conspiratorial whisper before revealing the surprise.
entries.zh: 她压低声音，像在密谋似的耳语，然后透露了那个惊喜。

entries.en: One prong of the old garden fork had bent against a stone.
entries.zh: 那把旧园艺叉的一根叉齿碰到石头，弯了。

entries.en: The archive's destruction caused an incalculable loss to local historical research.
entries.zh: 档案的毁坏给当地历史研究造成了无法估量的损失。

entries.en: I stupidly left the only key inside the locked car.
entries.zh: 我愚蠢地把唯一的钥匙留在了锁好的车里。

entries.en: The mayor made an undignified exit after slipping on the wet steps.
entries.zh: 市长在湿台阶上滑了一跤后，狼狈地离开了。

entries.en: They shared a strawberry sundae topped with cream and chopped nuts.
entries.zh: 他们分吃了一份草莓圣代，上面加了奶油和碎坚果。

entries.en: The difference between the two shades was almost imperceptible in daylight.
entries.zh: 在日光下，这两种色调的差别几乎难以察觉。

entries.en: A laboratory technologist demonstrated the equipment to the visiting students.
entries.zh: 一位实验室技术人员向来访学生演示了设备。

entries.en: He hung his gray fedora on the hook beside the door.
entries.zh: 他把灰色软呢帽挂在了门旁的钩子上。

entries.en: The children sat spellbound as the storyteller described the hidden kingdom.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人描述那个隐秘王国时，孩子们听得入了迷。

entries.en: The dental diagram showed an abscess near the root of a tooth.
entries.zh: 牙科示意图显示，一颗牙的牙根附近有个脓肿。

entries.en: A purple pansy bloomed in the little pot on her windowsill.
entries.zh: 她窗台上的小花盆里开着一朵紫色三色堇。

entries.en: Her stepson helped carry the boxes into their new apartment.
entries.zh: 她的继子帮忙把箱子搬进了他们的新公寓。

entries.en: The two clubs signed an agreement to formalise their existing partnership.
entries.zh: 两个俱乐部签署了协议，使已有的伙伴关系正式化。

entries.en: The museum closed the gallery as a precautionary measure during the inspection.
entries.zh: 检查期间，博物馆作为预防措施关闭了展厅。

entries.en: The article included verifiable details about the date and location of the meeting.
entries.zh: 文章包含了关于会议日期和地点的可核实细节。

entries.en: The little boy sniffled quietly while his mother searched for a tissue.
entries.zh: 妈妈找纸巾时，小男孩轻轻地抽着鼻子。

entries.en: The carpenter pressed fresh putty around the edge of the windowpane.
entries.zh: 木匠沿着窗玻璃的边缘压上了新油灰。

entries.en: The rearguard stayed near the bridge while the main force withdrew.
entries.zh: 主力撤退时，后卫部队留在桥附近。

entries.en: A bicyclist stopped to help us read the faded roadside map.
entries.zh: 一位骑自行车的人停下来，帮我们看路边褪色的地图。

entries.en: The essay examines competing explanations for overpopulation in the region.
entries.zh: 这篇文章研究了关于该地区人口过剩的几种相互竞争的解释。

entries.en: The owner's intransigence left little room for a compromise over the rent.
entries.zh: 房东不肯让步，租金问题几乎没有妥协余地。

entries.en: The editor described the deliberate invention of quotations as indefensible.
entries.zh: 编辑认为故意编造引语的行为无法辩护。

entries.en: The faded photograph preserved the scene imperfectly, with several faces barely visible.
entries.zh: 褪色照片没能完整保留当时的场景，好几张脸几乎看不清。

entries.en: The little kitchen was immaculately clean despite the afternoon's busy baking session.
entries.zh: 尽管下午忙着烘焙，小厨房仍然干净得一尘不染。

entries.en: The family matriarch greeted every guest from her favorite chair by the window.
entries.zh: 家中的女家长坐在窗边最喜欢的椅子上，迎接每一位客人。

entries.en: The novel portrays a town sliding into lawlessness after the authorities depart.
entries.zh: 小说描绘了一座城镇在当局离开后逐渐陷入无法无天的状态。

entries.en: A weedy path led from the abandoned house to the river.
entries.zh: 一条杂草丛生的小路从废弃的房屋通向河边。

entries.en: The mechanic pointed to the airbag warning light on the dashboard.
entries.zh: 机械师指了指仪表盘上的安全气囊警示灯。

entries.en: The waiter quickly wiped up the spillage beside the overturned glass.
entries.zh: 服务员迅速擦掉了倒下的玻璃杯旁洒出的液体。

entries.en: The astronomy class compared photographs showing changes in a large sunspot.
entries.zh: 天文学课上，大家比较了显示一个大太阳黑子变化的照片。

entries.en: The diary follows a young infantryman through his first winter at the front.
entries.zh: 这本日记记录了一名年轻步兵在前线度过第一个冬天的经历。

entries.en: Through the cabin's round porthole, we watched the harbor lights disappear.
entries.zh: 透过船舱圆圆的舷窗，我们看着港口的灯光渐渐消失。

entries.en: The abrupt changes caused growing disaffection among the company's experienced employees.
entries.zh: 这些突然的变动引起了公司老员工日益加深的不满。

entries.en: A chink in the shutters let a thin beam of sunlight enter.
entries.zh: 百叶窗的一道缝隙透进一束细细的阳光。

entries.en: He called his brother a copycat for choosing exactly the same costume.
entries.zh: 弟弟选了完全一样的服装，他便说弟弟是个模仿者。

entries.en: The cosmologist explained how distant galaxies provide clues about the early universe.
entries.zh: 这位宇宙学家解释了遥远星系如何提供早期宇宙的线索。

entries.en: The orchestra performed in an ancient amphitheatre beneath the evening sky.
entries.zh: 管弦乐团在暮色下的一座古代露天圆形剧场演出。

entries.en: Her course in toxicology included laboratory work and discussions of historical cases.
entries.zh: 她的毒理学课程包括实验室实践和历史案例讨论。

entries.en: The novel explores the stigma of illegitimacy in a nineteenth-century village.
entries.zh: 这部小说探讨了十九世纪村庄中非婚生身份带来的污名。

entries.en: After years of touring, the musician welcomed the quiet pleasures of domesticity.
entries.zh: 多年巡演之后，这位音乐家欣然享受起家庭生活的安静乐趣。

entries.en: The sharecropper paid the landowner with a portion of each harvest.
entries.zh: 这位分成制佃农把每次收成的一部分交给地主，作为租金。

entries.en: The vase had a bulbous base and a slender, curved neck.
entries.zh: 这个花瓶有一个鼓起的球状底部和细长弯曲的瓶颈。

entries.en: The essay argues for greater toleration of unfamiliar customs and beliefs.
entries.zh: 这篇文章主张对不熟悉的习俗和信仰更加宽容。

entries.en: He mentioned his occasional heartburn when the doctor asked about digestive symptoms.
entries.zh: 医生询问消化系统症状时，他提到了偶尔出现的胃灼热。

entries.en: I naively assumed the repairs would take only one afternoon.
entries.zh: 我天真地以为修理只需要一个下午。

entries.en: The small museum lacked the wherewithal to repair its leaking roof.
entries.zh: 这家小博物馆缺少修补漏雨屋顶所需的资金。

entries.meaningZh: 重新开发以促进经济发展
entries.en: The council hopes to redevelop the district and attract small businesses.
entries.zh: 市政委员会希望重新开发这个地区，吸引小企业进驻。

entries.en: Repeated delivery problems continued to bedevil the small furniture company.
entries.zh: 反复出现的送货问题继续困扰着这家小家具公司。

entries.en: The mountain road remained passable despite a thin covering of snow.
entries.zh: 尽管覆盖着一层薄雪，山路仍可通行。

entries.en: By dinnertime, everyone had returned from the beach with sand in their shoes.
entries.zh: 到晚餐时间，大家都从海滩回来了，鞋里带着沙子。

entries.en: She remained philosophic about the delay and settled down with a book.
entries.zh: 她对延误依然很达观，安然坐下读起了书。

entries.en: Regular customers are the lifeblood of the little shops along this street.
entries.zh: 常客是这条街上小商店维持生机的源泉。

entries.en: He lowered the truck's tailgate before unloading the bags of soil.
entries.zh: 他先放下卡车的后挡板，再卸下那几袋土。

entries.en: The room grew imperceptibly darker as clouds gathered beyond the window.
entries.zh: 窗外乌云聚集，房间在不知不觉中暗了下来。

entries.en: Books lay haphazardly across the floor beside the half-empty shelves.
entries.zh: 半空的书架旁，书本杂乱地摊在地板上。

entries.en: His gentlemanly manner made the nervous guests feel immediately at ease.
entries.zh: 他有绅士风度的举止让紧张的客人立刻放松下来。

entries.en: My phone rang embarrassingly loudly during the quietest moment of the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会最安静的时候，我的手机响得很大声，令人尴尬。

entries.en: The discovery was newsworthy enough to attract reporters from several national papers.
entries.zh: 这项发现很有新闻价值，吸引了几家全国性报纸的记者。

entries.en: The new manager was approachable and always made time for questions.
entries.zh: 新经理平易近人，总会抽时间回答问题。

entries.en: The neighbors settled their disagreement amicably over a cup of tea.
entries.zh: 邻居们喝着茶，友好地解决了分歧。

entries.en: The technician placed the sample inside a small ceramic crucible.
entries.zh: 技术员把样品放进了一个小陶瓷坩埚。

entries.en: The restored kitchen authentically reflects the modest life of its former owners.
entries.zh: 修复后的厨房真实地反映了原主人简朴的生活。

entries.en: The nutrition worksheet compared the caloric content of several common snacks.
entries.zh: 营养学练习表比较了几种常见零食的热量。

entries.en: His uncritical acceptance of every rumor frustrated the rest of the group.
entries.zh: 他对每条传闻都不加批判地接受，让组里其他人很无奈。

entries.en: His meanness showed when he refused to share even the leftover bread.
entries.zh: 他连剩下的面包都不肯分享，显出了他的吝啬。

entries.en: The researcher used a phenomenological approach to explore participants' experiences of grief.
entries.zh: 研究者采用现象学方法，探究参与者对悲伤的体验。

entries.meaningZh: 鸡奸（此处为旧法律用语）
entries.en: The historian examined old laws that classified anal intercourse as sodomy.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家研究了把肛交归类为鸡奸的旧法律。

entries.en: The essay discusses the place of procreation in the philosopher's account of family life.
entries.zh: 这篇文章讨论了生育在该哲学家对家庭生活的论述中的地位。

entries.en: She felt disloyal discussing her colleague's mistake with the rival team.
entries.zh: 与竞争团队谈论同事的错误，让她觉得自己不忠诚。

entries.en: The museum visit was educationally valuable as well as enjoyable for the children.
entries.zh: 参观博物馆对孩子们来说既有趣，又具有教育价值。

entries.en: The conservator examined the damaged painting under a bright adjustable lamp.
entries.zh: 文物保护修复员在一盏明亮的可调灯下检查受损的画作。

entries.en: The operator stopped the conveyor when the mechanical pusher jammed.
entries.zh: 机械推料机卡住时，操作员停下了传送带。

entries.en: The little cafe was charmingly decorated with flowers and old travel posters.
entries.zh: 这家小咖啡馆用鲜花和旧旅行海报装饰得很迷人。

entries.en: The company tested biodegradable packaging made from plant fibers.
entries.zh: 公司测试了用植物纤维制成的可生物降解包装。

entries.en: The plumber replaced a leaking urinal in the station restroom.
entries.zh: 水管工更换了车站卫生间里一个漏水的小便器。

entries.en: The historian argued that appeasement encouraged further demands from the aggressor.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家认为，姑息助长了侵略者提出更多要求。

entries.en: The investigation considered each manager's culpability for the missing safety records.
entries.zh: 调查考察了各位经理对安全记录丢失所负的过失责任。

entries.en: Bright confetti drifted onto the dancers as the final song began.
entries.zh: 最后一首歌响起时，鲜艳的五彩纸屑飘落到舞者身上。

entries.en: The magazine's relaunch included a new cover design and longer interviews.
entries.zh: 这本杂志重新推出时，采用了新的封面设计，并增加了更长的访谈。

entries.en: The kitchen staff sanitized the work surfaces after preparing the raw ingredients.
entries.zh: 厨房员工处理完生食材后，对工作台面进行了消毒。

entries.en: She regretfully declined the invitation because she had already promised to work.
entries.zh: 她因已答应上班而遗憾地谢绝了邀请。

entries.en: A tiny weevil crawled out of the opened bag of rice.
entries.zh: 一只小象鼻虫从打开的米袋里爬了出来。

entries.en: "Howdy!" the ranch owner called as we stepped out of the car.
entries.zh: 我们一下车，牧场主就喊道：“你们好！”

entries.en: His hands felt clammy as he waited outside the interview room.
entries.zh: 在面试室外等候时，他的双手感觉湿冷黏腻。

entries.en: The second photograph was fractionally darker than the first one.
entries.zh: 第二张照片比第一张稍微暗一点。

entries.en: The novel's wealthy playboy spends his summers drifting between fashionable resorts.
entries.zh: 小说中那位富有的花花公子每年夏天都辗转于时髦的度假胜地。

entries.en: Freshly cut logs arrived at the sawmill on long flatbed trucks.
entries.zh: 刚砍下的原木由长平板卡车运抵锯木厂。

entries.en: She discovered a talent for archery during the school's outdoor activity week.
entries.zh: 学校户外活动周期间，她发现自己有射箭天赋。

entries.en: The shop priced its handmade soap competitively against larger brands.
entries.zh: 这家店为手工皂制定了能与大品牌竞争的价格。

entries.en: The animator gave the tiny bird an expressive face and awkward walk.
entries.zh: 动画制作师赋予那只小鸟生动的表情和笨拙的步态。

entries.en: Visitors gathered in the marble rotunda before entering the main exhibition.
entries.zh: 游客在进入主展厅前，聚集在大理石圆形大厅里。

entries.en: The old ledger records the tithe paid by each farming household.
entries.zh: 这本旧账册记载了每个农户缴纳的什一税。

entries.en: His explanation carried a note of condescension that irritated the experienced volunteers.
entries.zh: 他的解释带着居高临下的口气，惹恼了有经验的志愿者们。

entries.en: The ventilation system supplied breathable air to the underground work area.
entries.zh: 通风系统向地下工作区输送适宜呼吸的空气。

entries.en: The repairman found a loose wire behind the washing machine's control panel.
entries.zh: 修理工在洗衣机控制面板后面发现了一根松动的电线。

entries.en: He wore a cotton undershirt beneath his crisp white office shirt.
entries.zh: 他在挺括的白色上班衬衫里面穿了一件棉汗衫。

entries.en: The exhibition featured a bus designed to run on locally produced biofuel.
entries.zh: 展览展出了一辆设计为使用当地产生的生物燃料运行的公交车。

entries.en: The workshop ended with an unstructured discussion of participants' remaining questions.
entries.zh: 工作坊以一场不设固定结构的讨论结束，大家谈了尚未解决的问题。

entries.en: She slyly slipped an extra biscuit into her brother's coat pocket.
entries.zh: 她偷偷往弟弟的大衣口袋里又塞了一块饼干。

entries.en: The exercise asked students to choose a connective linking the two clauses.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求学生选择一个连接词，将两个分句连起来。

entries.en: The exhibit shows the insect's larval stage beside its adult form.
entries.zh: 展品把这种昆虫的幼虫阶段与成虫形态并列展示。

entries.en: She peeled a tangerine and shared the bright segments with her son.
entries.zh: 她剥开一个橘子，把鲜亮的橘瓣分给儿子。

entries.en: The children's uninhibited dancing soon drew the adults onto the floor.
entries.zh: 孩子们无拘无束的舞蹈很快吸引大人们也下场跳了起来。

entries.en: The company denied that the sudden dismissal was a retaliatory act.
entries.zh: 公司否认这次突然解雇是报复行为。

entries.en: One cable remained unattached after we finished assembling the speakers.
entries.zh: 我们装好扬声器后，还有一根电缆没有接上。

entries.en: The villagers regarded the ancient burial ground as sacrosanct.
entries.zh: 村民们把那片古老的墓地视为神圣不可侵犯之地。

entries.en: Each student received a workbook containing maps and short reading exercises.
entries.zh: 每个学生都拿到一本包含地图和简短阅读练习的练习册。

entries.en: The organizer prudently reserved a second room in case attendance exceeded expectations.
entries.zh: 组织者谨慎地多订了一个房间，以防到场人数超出预期。

entries.en: He upended the empty bucket to shake out the last grains of sand.
entries.zh: 他把空桶倒过来，抖出最后几粒沙子。

entries.en: Cooking Sunday lunch created a warm sense of togetherness in the family.
entries.zh: 一起做星期日午餐让一家人感到温暖而亲密。

entries.en: He regarded the secret negotiations as an act of disloyalty.
entries.zh: 他把这些秘密谈判视为一种不忠行为。

entries.en: The robotic manipulator lifted the glass tube without touching its open end.
entries.zh: 机械手抬起了玻璃管，没有碰到它敞开的一端。

entries.en: The film traces a man's homophobic fears back to his strict upbringing.
entries.zh: 影片将一个男人对同性恋的恐惧追溯到他所受的严厉教育。

entries.en: The little hotel was pricy, but its location suited our short visit.
entries.zh: 这家小旅馆价格昂贵，但位置适合我们短期停留。

entries.en: A barn owl flew silently past the haystack at the edge of the field.
entries.zh: 一只仓鸮无声地飞过田边的干草堆。

entries.en: She searched vainly through the drawers for the missing receipt.
entries.zh: 她翻遍抽屉寻找丢失的收据，却徒劳无功。

entries.en: The poet used an oxymoron to combine tenderness with a sense of threat.
entries.zh: 诗人运用矛盾修辞法，把温柔与威胁感结合起来。

entries.en: The restaurant occupied an undistinguished building on a quiet side street.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅坐落在安静小街上一栋平凡的建筑里。

entries.en: The sudden shower caught us unawares halfway across the open field.
entries.zh: 我们穿过开阔田野走到一半时，突然的阵雨让我们措手不及。

entries.en: The unfocused image showed only blurred shapes behind the frosted glass.
entries.zh: 这张未聚焦的影像只显示出磨砂玻璃后模糊的轮廓。

entries.en: The returning musicians received a rapturous welcome from the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 归来的音乐家们受到了满场观众狂热的欢迎。

entries.en: The textbook uses clear diagrams to explain the stages of foetal development.
entries.zh: 教科书用清晰的示意图解释胎儿发育的各个阶段。

entries.en: He began to cuss when the suitcase handle broke in his hand.
entries.zh: 行李箱把手在手里断掉时，他开始咒骂起来。

entries.en: The meeting became farcical when three people claimed to be its chair.
entries.zh: 三个人都声称自己是主席，会议变得滑稽荒唐。

entries.en: The abandoned house was disturbingly quiet after the shouting suddenly stopped.
entries.zh: 叫喊声突然停止后，那座废弃房屋安静得令人不安。

entries.en: The club faced accusations of elitism after restricting membership to university graduates.
entries.zh: 俱乐部把会员资格限定为大学毕业生后，受到了精英主义的指责。

entries.en: The cook sliced the tender brisket and arranged it on a warm plate.
entries.zh: 厨师把鲜嫩的牛胸肉切片，摆在温热的盘子上。

entries.en: The residents worried that commercialism would overwhelm the festival's community spirit.
entries.zh: 居民们担心商业至上主义会淹没节日的社区精神。

entries.en: The story follows a lonely drifter searching for somewhere to settle.
entries.zh: 故事讲述一个孤独的漂泊者寻找安身之处的经历。

entries.en: Her assistant ably managed the office throughout her month-long absence.
entries.zh: 她离开的一个月里，助手出色地管理着办公室。

entries.en: The renovation revealed an unsuspected doorway behind the old wooden shelves.
entries.zh: 翻修时，人们在旧木架后发现了一道未曾料到的门。

entries.en: The medical student borrowed a textbook on obstetrics from the university library.
entries.zh: 这名医学生从大学图书馆借了一本产科学教科书。

entries.en: Her spiteful remarks spoiled what had otherwise been a pleasant evening.
entries.zh: 她恶意的言论破坏了原本愉快的夜晚。

entries.meaningZh: 主张宗教与教育分离的人
entries.en: The secularist argued that public education should remain independent of religious institutions.
entries.zh: 这位主张宗教与教育分离的人认为，公共教育应当独立于宗教机构。

entries.en: The biology illustration showed the fish's innards in a labeled cross-section.
entries.zh: 这幅生物学插图用带标注的剖面展示了鱼的内脏。

entries.en: The council rehoused the families after the fire damaged their apartment building.
entries.zh: 公寓楼遭火灾损坏后，市政委员会为这些家庭安排了新住房。

entries.en: A pile of unwashed dishes stood beside the kitchen sink.
entries.zh: 厨房水槽旁堆着一摞没洗的餐具。

entries.en: He perversely refused the comfortable chair and sat on the floor instead.
entries.zh: 他固执地拒绝坐那把舒适的椅子，偏要坐在地板上。

entries.en: The philosophy course contrasted rationalism with theories that emphasize sensory experience.
entries.zh: 这门哲学课程将理性主义与强调感官经验的理论进行了对比。

entries.en: The museum's display included a restored gunship from an earlier conflict.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展品中有一架来自早期冲突、经过修复的武装直升机。

entries.en: The novel describes how the estate owner dispossessed several tenant families.
entries.zh: 这部小说描述了庄园主如何剥夺了几个佃户家庭的财产。

entries.en: The camp's latrine stood behind a wooden screen near the trees.
entries.zh: 营地的坑厕位于树木附近的一道木屏障后。

entries.en: Her cleverness showed in the simple way she solved the storage problem.
entries.zh: 她用简单的方法解决了收纳难题，显出了她的聪明才智。

entries.en: The waterlogged soil held deep footprints long after the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 雨停了很久，浸满水的泥土上仍留着深深的脚印。

entries.en: Workers loaded the wooden crates into a boxcar beside the warehouse.
entries.zh: 工人把木箱装进仓库旁的一节有盖铁路货车。

entries.en: The quietness of the village surprised us after a week in the city.
entries.zh: 在城里待了一周后，村庄的寂静让我们感到意外。

entries.en: The soldiers lined up outside the paymaster's office on Friday morning.
entries.zh: 星期五早晨，士兵们在薪饷出纳员的办公室外排队。

entries.en: They produced the entire play on a shoestring with borrowed costumes.
entries.zh: 他们借来戏服，用很少的资金完成了整部戏的制作。

entries.en: A cold northerly wind drove the fishing boats back toward the harbor.
entries.zh: 一阵寒冷的北风迫使渔船驶回港口。

entries.en: The beachfront hotel had a narrow balcony overlooking the morning swimmers.
entries.zh: 这家临海滩的旅馆有个狭窄的阳台，可以俯瞰清晨的游泳者。

entries.en: The informality of the gathering encouraged even the shyest guests to speak.
entries.zh: 聚会轻松随意的气氛让最害羞的客人也愿意开口。

entries.en: We gathered by the fireside while snow settled on the garden outside.
entries.zh: 屋外花园渐渐积起了雪，我们聚在炉边。
